# Leisure Vehicle & Auto Repairs

> Independent vehicle servicing, repairs and inspections based in Newton Abbot, Devon.

- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/leisurevehiclesandautorepairs
- Service area: Newton Abbot, Torbay and surrounding areas
- Experience: Over 18 years of hands-on experience

## Services

- Pre-purchase vehicle inspections, from £40; scope and price depend on the vehicle
- Car and van servicing, repairs and diagnostics
- Motorhome and campervan habitation checks
- Electrical and water-system checks
- Mobile visits may be available depending on the vehicle, work, location and conditions
